2024_general.fact: Elections History lists one file, 'November 5, 2024 General Election (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 411): Official Results, county totals only (scan CreationDate Nov 18 2024). No election-night file survives. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Official Cumulative Reports with Reconciliation (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 3104): Official Results, Run Date 03/12/2026, county totals only; 'March 3, 2026 Preliminary Election Reconciliation' is a totals form scanned Mar 4. No election-night results file survives. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Cumulative Report w Preliminary Reconciliation (PDF)' (DocumentCenter 3269): 'Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results ... Polling Places Reporting 6 of 6 ... Run Time 9:11 PM ... Run Date 05/26/2026', county totals by vote type only (PDF CreationDate May 27 02:23 UTC = 9:23 PM CDT). Official cumulative (3286, run 06/03/2026) also county totals only. No precinct numbers published online.

rationale: Only the 2026 runoff is determined (LATER: unofficial cumulative county totals printed 9:11 PM election night, no precinct results), so COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with confidence low (DocumentCenter gives no upload time).
